title: New Medicaid fraud offense will now send offenders to prison after Attorney General Ellison's intervention
supports: The AG states that 2026 legislation created new Medicaid-fraud offense levels for theft over $100,000 and over $1,000,000.
The AG states that the Minnesota Sentencing Guidelines Commission ranked Medicaid fraud over $1,000,000 at Severity Level 8 in the 2026 Sentencing Guidelines.
The AG characterizes Severity Level 8 as carrying presumptive prison commitment regardless of criminal history.
does_not_support: For controlling legal citations, use the enacted session law/Revisor text and final 2026 Sentencing Guidelines rather than relying solely on this press release.
Effective-date and ex post facto questions require conduct-date analysis.
next_primary_sources: 2026 Minnesota session law creating the new Medicaid-fraud offenses
